class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/Mujoco3dLidarPlugin
class.description: Publishes single-row mujoco.plugin.lidar sensor data as sensor_msgs/LaserScan and multi-row sensor data as sensor_msgs/PointCloud2.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/StateCapturePlugin
class.description: Captures simulation time and qpos into a bounded real-time-safe ring buffer and periodically writes the samples to a CSV file from a consumer thread.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/ObstacleControlPlugin
class.description: Pins a free obstacle body to a configured pose and offers a service for changing its XY position.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/FoodControlPlugin
class.description: Offers a service for throwing free food bodies into configured parking areas.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/SimulationStateProviderPlugin
class.description: Provides the live generalized positions and managed obstacle pose and dimensions.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/LockRobotBasePlugin
class.description: Offers lock_base and unlock_base services that pin the free-floating robot base to the pose it held when the lock service was called.
